title: ChatGPT Research Preview
summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT on November 30, 2022 as a conversational model and research preview intended to gather user feedback. OpenAI stated that ChatGPT was fine-tuned from a model in the GPT-3.5 series and trained using reinforcement learning from human feedback.
significance: A dated first-party public introduction and research-preview milestone for ChatGPT.
